page.overview:
What is B'gnu-Thun?

B'gnu-Thun (The Soul-Chilling Ice-God) is a Great Old One from the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character is only briefly mentioned in the James Ambuehl short stories "The Stalker in the Snows" and "Correlated Contents", in which B'gnu-Thun is described as being the twin brother of Ruhtra Dyoll, and appears as a humanoid figure made of ice followed by an eerie blizzard.
